app/Reports/BuildSalesReport.php:20 report takes an untyped-at-runtime array shape instead of named args or a small DTO

v.rationale: All three share the same overall design (FormRequest -> invokable controller -> report action with #[Scope] scopes, Number::currency, enum cast) and all pass their tests. impl-3 is ranked last because it uses 'sometimes' instead of 'nullable', so sending any optional param empty returns 422 instead of using the defaults; it also duplicates a filter chain and has a factory that queries the database for every item. impl-1 and impl-2 are both correct on every probe I ran (empty params, array params, impossible dates, inclusive end-of-day, country case, combined filters, an order with no items). impl-2 wins on simplicity and consistency: one join strategy throughout, qualified columns, configurable currency. impl-1 mixes a whereHas+mergeConstraintsFrom revenue query with join-based breakdowns, needs toBase()/selectRaw/coalesce, and has a misleadingly named LINE_TOTAL constant, although its tests are slightly richer.
